findings.title: Allow the exact recovered creation identity before consuming native events
findings.analysis: Crash after confirmed thread/start but before saving binding leaves document.thread_id null. Initial connection retain_threads and allow_thread omit it. configure_thread adopts the exact confirmed identity at1451 but never updates the receive allowlist. Subsequent turn/start and thread/read consume and permanently discard notifications for this valid current binding. A later bind cycle permits future events but cannot restore discarded ones.
findings.fix: After validating/adopting the exact creation receipt, allow its thread before any further RPC. Cover recovered first-turn notification delivery.

findings.title: Preserve terminal evidence and pending cleanup across retirement retries
findings.analysis: An unsubscribe error leaves state revoking. The next pass unconditionally repeats shutdown_turn and overwrites its saved terminal receipt. A later native lookup/history error replaces confirmed termination with unknown and omits store/incarnation. retire_subscription then returns Ok(unknown) at439-444; the binding can reach revoked at371 and is excluded by the next selection at258 while an earlier unsubscribe operation remains unknown. This loses retained observed disposition and automatic reconciliation of that pending cleanup.
findings.fix: Keep confirmed stop disposition immutable across cleanup retries, record later failures separately, and independently qualify/reconcile the connection-scoped unsubscribe before finishing retirement. Cover lost unsubscribe acknowledgement followed by failed history read.
findings.validation: Source traced independently; GREEN lost-ack fixture retries with successful stop/history qualification and does not exercise the failure sequence.
